text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 99 vials of adenosine 3 mg/mL 2 mL at 16.9 vials per day, giving 5.9 days on hand. Corvale General holds 235 vials of the same presentation at 15.2 vials per day, giving 15.4 days on hand. Both sites' supply traces to Gland Pharma Limited (NDC 68083015610), a registered plant with VAI inspections through 2024-07-25. Other presentations at Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside show adequate days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show adenosine is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The risk is local to Corvale East's 2 mL vial inventory. Alternate manufacturers Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Gland Pharma Limited, and Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 21 vials of adenosine 3 mg/mL 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Eugia US LLC — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Gland Pharma Limited — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol adjustments; those are for the treating clinicians and the committee.
